subject: Capacity & Error Spikes — Proposed Remediation and Commercial Remedy for VeloX
messages:
From: Jin Park <jin.park@velox.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Liu <samantha@velox.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production: elevated latency/errors this morning — request for credits and remediation

Monica / Laura,

We experienced a significant degradation in inference performance across our US region between 07:10–08:35 PDT today. Symptoms: sustained 200–400ms additional tail latency on multi-token streaming calls, a spike in 5xx error rate to ~4.8% (typically <0.1%), and dropped throughput for our burst workloads. This impacted several customer-facing features and triggered our fallbacks.

Our SREs attached a brief timeline and sample request IDs (attached). We need a clear remediation plan, a root-cause ETA, and a commercial remedy for the April/May invoice given the SLA breaches. Please escalate — this is in front of our CTO and Head of Product.

Requesting:
- A technical post-mortem and mitigation timeline within 24 hours
- Proposed credit calculation for affected windows
- A short-term operational workaround while you fix the root cause

Thanks,
Jin Park
Head of Platform, VeloX AI
--
attachments: velox_request_ids.txt (text), velox_sre_timeline.csv (csv)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jin Park <jin.park@velox.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: elevated latency/errors this morning — request for credits and remediation

Jin — thank you for the quick heads up and the attachments. I'm escalating now and will own the customer communication until we have a remediation offer. 

Immediate actions we've taken:
- Triggered priority pager for Serving Runtime (ENG-ops); baseline tracing and KV cache checks are running
- Provisioned a small, hot spare pool to re-route bursts to a different shard to reduce tail latency impact
- Assigned Laura Bennett as the incident lead for customer comms and Rishi to draft commercial options

Can you confirm whether the affected traffic was pinned to a single model variant or across multiple? That will help sizing the required capacity changes. We'll come back within 6–8 hours with a concrete short-term mitigation and a proposed credit schedule.

We understand this is material — I will loop in Markus and Sean for exec-level review.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0199
--
attachments: none

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production: elevated latency/errors this morning — internal: proposed remediation draft

Team — forwarding Jin's note with SRE artifacts. Summary of customer impact: several customer-facing features degraded for ~85 minutes; observed tail latency and 5xx spike correlating with autoscaling/queue saturation under burst traffic. VeloX is asking for root cause, credits, and short-term workarounds — CTO is engaged.

Draft commercial remediation (internal):
- Immediate: offer a service credit for May invoice calculated as 25% of one month's committed spend for outages matching "major" SLA breach (rolling metric criteria attached)
- Technical remediation: dedicated engineering / on-call hours for 2 weeks (priority bugfix lane + weekly sync) + temporary increase in reservation by one medium GPU pool for 30 days at our cost to stabilize throughput
- Contract: propose a one-page amendment to explicitly add a latency SLO and an escalations clause + service credit schedule; offer DocuSign link for acceptance
- Comms: 24-hour post-mortem followed by full RCA within 5 business days

Open questions for legal/finance: can we cap aggregate credit at 40% of one monthly committed fee? Do we need pre-approval for offering a 25% credit or should we propose 20% and escalate to finance for 25–40%?

PRIORITY ACTIONS:
- Rishi: please advise on credit cap and sample wording for the amendment
- Laura: prepare the 24-hour interim update for VeloX and propose meeting slots
- Markus/Sean: exec view on extra credit if customer escalates to renewal/expansion decision-maker

Attaching quick impact analysis and a proposed remedy doc (draft language).

Thanks,
Monica
--
attachments: impact_analysis_may2026.pdf, proposed_remedy_draft.docx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: elevated latency/errors this morning — internal: proposed remediation draft

Suggested edits / commercial position:
- Credit: agree on showing willingness to compensate. Recommend offering 25% as an opening public offer for May given impact and CTO engagement. Internally authorize up to 40% aggregated credit but require pre-approval above 30% from Finance.
- Monetary alternative: if customer prefers a fixed USD credit instead of percent, suggest $75,000 capped credit for this incident (whichever is greater for the customer value metric).
- Duration: 2-week priority engineering plus a 30-day stability credit (i.e., additional monitoring + dedicated queueing).
- Add a one-time goodwill onboarding: 2 technical enablement sessions for their SREs + sharing of longer-term batching/quantization recommendations to avoid recurrence.

Legal note: amendment must be explicit on measurement windows and excluded maintenance windows. I can draft the amendment language today to expedite.

If we offer 25% publicly, we keep the 40% cap as an escalation path during renewal discussions.

Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
--
attachments: none

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jin Park <jin.park@velox.ai>
Cc: Samantha Liu <samantha@velox.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: elevated latency/errors this morning — remediation offer and next steps

Jin / Samantha — thanks again for raising this and for the SRE artifacts. We’ve completed an initial assessment and wanted to propose a remediation and commercial remedy to resolve this quickly: 

Summary of offer (initial):
- Service credit: 25% credit applied to VeloX's May 2026 committed spend (applies to monthly committed fee line item)
- Technical stabilization: priority 2-week engineering slot to implement/fix root cause mitigation + temporary +1 GPU pool for 30 days at Redwood's cost to stabilize burst throughput
- Operational improvements: 24-hour interim post-mortem (tomorrow) and a full RCA in 5 business days; two SRE enablement sessions and a handover of batching/quantization recommendations
- Contract: one-page amendment detailing measurement windows and the service credit schedule (DocuSign link below). If you prefer a USD flat credit, we can offer a $75,000 one-time credit as an alternative.

Acceptance and next steps:
- Please confirm by replying to this thread which credit option you prefer (25% or $75k).
- If confirmed, we will issue the credit within the next billing cycle and route the engineering slot to begin Monday next week.
- DocuSign: https://docusign.redwood.com/velox-amendment-v1

We want to restore full trust and are committed to a transparent RCA. If VeloX wants to discuss a larger commercial package given potential renewal timing, mark that and I'll escalate to Markus/Sean for direct conversation.

Best,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0199
--
